Cluster Contexts:
- Laezel_InParty2_Nested_TopicalGreetings.json: The party has been haunted by a recurring dream‑visitor that points them toward the Absolute cultists' lair and offers a tempting “gift” — a new psionic ability or power. Off‑screen the player is infected with a tadpole and is actively seeking the source of the tadpoles, so choices include using the visitor’s skill to manipulate cultists, following the cultists to trace the source, or refusing the gift. Lae'zel, a recently recruited and still‑suspicious Githyanki, distrusts the visitor as illithid corruption, warns the player to avert their eyes, and may press or attempt psychic probes into the player’s mind over these matters. These lines can play once or persist until cancelled and feed back into the companion InParty interactions and later endgame confrontations.
- GOB_Orpheus_VoiceOfAbsolute.json: Before entering the goblin camp, a scene triggers in which the party hear the voice of the Absolute, and experience a vision of its Chosen Three (Ketheric, Gortash and Orin). The voice orders the player to help the three find the Orpheus artefact and to seek 'the path of illumination'.If a party member in the group has the Orpheus box in their inventory, they take it into their hands. It glows brighter and brighter, and then the voice and visions stop. The light from the box then fades, and the player(s) discuss the apparent protection the box provided from the Absolute’s influence.If no party member in the group has the Orpheus box in their inventory,and Shadowheart isn't alive to show up, the visions and voice will cause the party to pass out and experience a forced camp night where they receive the box.NOTE: this dialogue contains narrator nodes that're intended to be player-forward in the medium term until NPC assets are available for cinematics.
- CAMP_DaisyMissionStatement_AvD.json: Daisy reacts to whichever route we took to learn that the tadpoles are imbued with special magic. They tell us that it’s part of a greater sickness. The Cult of the Absolute is winning a war nobody is aware of - if they are victorious we will all be doomed. But we can stop this if we join Daisy in the quest to bring down the Absolute. We need to use our powers to infiltrate the ranks. At the end of the dream, Daisy gives us a new tadpole power.
- EPI_Epilogue_MindFlayerUrge.json: When a mind flayer avatar speaks to a character (a randomly chosen one through script), this dialog will play in which they must roll to resist consuming the brain of the character. It only plays once.
- UND_MyconidCircle_RapportSpores_WithCompanions.json: The party has heard a strange voice in their heads while exploring the depths of the Underdark They discuss it - is it their tadpole? A hallucination? Something else? They don't know.

context: The party has been haunted by a recurring dream‑visitor who points them toward the Absolute cultists' lair and tempts them with a “gift” — effectively a new psionic/tadpole ability — while the player is secretly infected with a tadpole and is actively seeking its source. Lae'zel distrusts the visitor, regards it as illithid corruption, and repeatedly warns the player to avert their eyes and refuse the offered power; she may press the issue or attempt psychic probes. Depending on choices, the player can accept the skill to manipulate cultists, follow the cultists to trace the tadpole origin, or refuse the gift; other scripted TG nodes (or specific cancel conditions) can end or replace these lines. These exchanges can play once or persist and will feed back into companion InParty interactions and later confrontations.
